shots.action: A storm batters a stone lighthouse on a rocky headland; waves burst white below as rain streaks across the tower and the camera eases toward the lantern room.
shots.what_changes: The scene opens on the storm-bound lighthouse and pushes attention up the tower.

shots.action: Inside, the keeper in a dripping oilskin climbs the spiral stone stairs, one hand on the wet rail and a storm lantern swinging at his side; lightning flashes through a narrow window and briefly throws his shadow across the curving wall.
shots.what_changes: The keeper advances upward past the window as lightning briefly lights the stairwell.

shots.action: At the lamp-room door the keeper leans into the wind, forces it open, and crosses to the cold lamp housing; he wipes rain from the glass and reaches for the ignition mechanism.
shots.what_changes: He enters the lamp room and reaches the unlit lamp mechanism.

shots.action: The keeper turns the mechanism; a flame catches inside the housing, the great lens begins to rotate, and a bright beam cuts out through the storm as a low string score rises beneath the wind.
shots.what_changes: The lamp ignites, the lens turns, and the beam sweeps into the storm.

subjects.description: A tall weathered stone lighthouse on a rocky headland, its lantern room dark during the storm.
A night storm of driving rain, wind, and distant lightning.
A black, heaving sea breaking in white surf against the rocks below the lighthouse.
A narrow spiral stone staircase inside the lighthouse, damp and wet from the storm.
A lighthouse keeper wrapped in a dripping oilskin, climbing the tower stairs and tending the lamp.
A cold brass-and-glass lighthouse lamp housing with an ignition mechanism.
A large glass lighthouse lens with brass fittings and rotating prisms.
